d:
Shri hanumanashtak aadity garhvi ke bhavyukt svar men. sankatmochan hanumanashtak ki sanrachna gosvami tulsidas ne ki thi. mana jata hai ki sankatmochan hanumanashtak ka path karne se vyakti apni har badha aur pira se mukt ho jata hai aur uske sabhi sankat dur ho jate hain.
Watch the video song of "Kaga Sang Khele Ram Salone" now!
Bal samay men shri ram se khelne ke lie kagbhushundi ji ek kag ke rup men aate the tab shri ram unse bahut der tak khela karte the yahi drishy dekh kar devashri narad ji ye git gate hain.
"svar- ravindr jain
Git- ravindr jain
Sangit- ravindr jain"
